name: GTM Holdings Corporation
summary: Established in Taipei City, Taiwan, in 1951, GTM Holdings Corporation operates a multifaceted business through its subsidiaries, focusing on real estate, textiles, electronics, and investment. The company's real estate division is responsible for developing and leasing commercial spaces, including office complexes, retail shopping centers, and logistics facilities. Within the textile sector, GTM manufactures and trades various goods such as knitwear, wool quilts, and suits, alongside engaging in the wholesale and retail distribution of fabrics. Additionally, its electronics segment specializes in the production and sale of analog integrated circuit (IC) packaging and testing products.
